name: decision-validation-defaults
body: Source: 'validates the whole deck… errors carry full path'. Unstated: whether validation stops at first error. Resolution (revised by user): validation is fail-fast — stop at the first error and report exactly one clear error. Theme omitted = `default` (the single built-in EY-look theme). `navigation` omitted = `default` (reveal.js navigationMode). [with user]
